name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road in a day
description_md:
The Grossglockner High Alpine Road in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk in Austria. This route is anchored in Grossglockner High Alpine Road and takes walkers between the city's main sights.

The itinerary features 5 sightseeing stops with 14.1 km of walking between them. The full day takes about 7.0 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
